info.title: Talaria Web API
info.description: HTTP and SSE contract of the Talaria Web server. Generated from @maudecode/talaria-web-contracts; do not edit by hand.

get.summary: Liveness and release identity; `deep=1` adds startup and store probes.
Public runtime configuration and initial state for the shell.
Sidebar rows for the active profile.
One session with a bounded message window.
Public read of a shared conversation snapshot.
Lightweight branch badge for a session workspace.

post.summary: Generate a commit message for the staged diff through the auxiliary model.
Remove the successful prefix of one failed multi-file chat upload.
Admit one agent turn and return the stream id for `/api/chat/stream`.
Ephemeral side question answered in a hidden session that inherits the transcript.

get.summary: Live agent-turn relay (SSE). Journal-backed frames carry `id: <stream_id>:<seq>`; resume with `after_event_id`, `after_seq`, or `Last-Event-ID`.

parameters.name: replay
parameters.description: `1` replays the journal from the start.

404.description: No live stream and no journal.

parameters.name: known_count
parameters.description: Last message count the tab rendered; a higher persisted count triggers `session-updated`.

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: `1` merges the gateway feed with a `stream` discriminator and an initial `gateway_status` frame.

get.summary: Per-session run-journal relay with `Last-Event-ID` resume and `session_snapshot` fallback.

parameters.name: after_event_id
parameters.description: Resume cursor when the header is unavailable.

get.summary: Raw bytes of a workspace file or a session upload.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session whose workspace anchors the path.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: `1` serves HTML inline under a CSP sandbox.

200.description: File bytes with ETag and byte-range support.

206.description: Partial content for a satisfiable Range header.

404.description: Path outside the workspace or missing.

get.summary: Local media referenced by the chat (allow-listed roots, MEDIA: tokens, or an immutable snapshot).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session whose assistant messages may grant the path.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: `1` allows inline audio, video, PDF, and sandboxed HTML.

parameters.name: snap
parameters.description: SHA-256 digest of a message-level snapshot bound to the path.

403.description: Path not in an allowed location.

get.summary: ZIP of a workspace folder (symlinks escaping the workspace are skipped).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session whose workspace anchors the path.

413.description: Folder exceeds the configured size or file-count cap.

get.summary: Transcript download as JSON or a self-contained HTML page.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: HTML only: base64 JSON map of CSS variables captured from the live UI.

post.summary: Store one chat attachment in the session inbox and return a rollback receipt.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Target session (the multipart `session_id` field wins when present).
